name: Resistor Environment QA 7
description: Multiple choice question about electricity, resistors and current QA: Equivalent resistance and potential difference across resistors in a network

examples.input: In a network with \SI{10}{\volt} EMF, resistances \SI{40}{\ohm}, \SI{100}{\ohm}, and \SI{150}{\ohm} are connected. {"topology": {"resistors": {"R1": \SI{40}{\ohm}, "R2": \SI{100}{\ohm}, "R3": \SI{150}{\ohm}}, "connections": [["A", "C", "R1"], ["C", "D", "R2"], ["C", "D", "R3"]]}}.  What is the potential difference across CD?
